m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>The gate to the Basstille Prison is heavy and strong, but the Empress's key fits perfectly and the gate quietly opens. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You slip inside and find no guards are watching the gate. The guards seem focused on their patrol. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Across the courtyard, you see the entrance to Cell Block A. </ITALICS>
You are champions of freedom. Truly. I cannot thank you enough for liberating me from the clutches of these cowardly fools.
Unfortunately, Minak escaped along with the last ship full of prisoners. It is regrettable, but nothing could be done.
The day can still be ours though, if we can overthrow the tyrant Antuskette and this Rasputin, who advises her.
I must reconvene with the Patriôtes to plan our next move! To the Nettoyage! I will see you there.
Ivan is in your debt, comrade. You have his word he will see to your business. First though, he is committed to helping Patriôtes.
Their cause is just, but they cannot do this alone. Let us aid them in liberating city from Walrusk Empress, then we talk business.
Ivan will follow Danton to ensure he is safe. See you at Nettoyage.
Voila! Now we are all here, and I can make my speech. I have dreamt of this moment for what seems to have been all eternity!
But did you get the key to the Basstille? Thank the stars! At long last, the hour for revolution has arrived. I will rally the Patriôtes.
You have done so much already, but I must ask even more. You must storm the Basstille and rescue Danton.
Look in Cell Block A. Find your friend Ivan first. Perhaps he can help you save Danton before the Iron Paws realize his importance.
Good luck. The fate of every Pingouin in this city depends on you, but there is none I would trust more with such a responsibility.
By the time you have rescued Danton from the Basstille, the Patriôtes will be ready. We will win this day, whatever it takes.
